files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A vertical navigation: the brand at the top, the links stacked, the user at the bottom. Axes: width (full:
  icon and name, compact: icons only with the name hidden), user (show, hide), density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

export type SidebarNavProps = {
  label: string;
  brand: string;
  links: NavLink[];
  current?: string;
  userName: string;
  userEmail: string;
  width?: "full" | "compact";
  user?: "show" | "hide";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.vue";
import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

const {
  label,
  brand,
  links,
  current = "",
  userName,
  userEmail,
  width = "full",
  user = "show",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SidebarNavProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="aside"
    :class="cn(
      'flex min-h-96 flex-col gap-6 rounded bg-card p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border',
      (((width as string) === 'compact') ? 'w-20 items-center' : 'w-64')
    )"
    :aria-label="(landmarkLabel ?? brand)"
    data-testid="sidebar"
    :data-width="width"
  >
    <Group gap="2" align="center">
      <LucideIcon name="layers" :size="24" />
      <Text size="base" weight="bold" :class="(((width as string) === 'compact') ? 'sr-only' : '')">
        {{ brand }}
      </Text>
    </Group>
    <NavBlock
      v-if="((links?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
      :label="(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', label, landmarkLabel)) : label)"
      class="flex-1"
    >
      <List
        :class="cn(
          'm-0 flex list-none flex-col p-0',
          (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'gap-0' : 'gap-2')
        )"
        data-testid="items"
      >
        <ListItem v-for="l in links" :key="l.id">
          <MenuEntry
            :href="l.href"
            :class="cn(
              'flex items-center gap-4 rounded px-4 text-sm',
              'py-2',
              ((l.id === current) ? 'bg-muted font-semibold' : '')
            )"
            :current="(l.id === current)"
            testid="item"
          >
            <LucideIcon :name="l.icon" :size="16" />
            <Inline :class="(((width as string) === 'compact') ? 'sr-only' : '')">
              {{ l.name }}
            </Inline>
          </MenuEntry>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </NavBlock>
    <Group
      v-if="((user as string) === 'show')"
      gap="4"
      align="center"
      class="border-t border-border pt-4"
      data-testid="user"
    >
      <MediaFrame :alt="userName" ratio="1/1" class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
      <Stack gap="0" :class="(((width as string) === 'compact') ? 'sr-only' : 'min-w-0')">
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {{ userName }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ userEmail }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
  </Block>
</template>
